summary_markdown:
A demo is scheduled for the Kyiv area from 13:00 to 14:00 for a Finnish client. Participants requested that no experiments, deployments, or hotfixes be run during this time slot to prevent system slowdowns.

Regarding the environment, [p11] confirmed the demo will run on production (prod), but unreleased demographics will be shown using staging data.
decisions: No experiments, deployments, or hotfixes are allowed in Kyiv between 13:00 and 14:00 for the Finland demo.
